The current draft’s claim that safety protocols were “fully implemented” must be struck immediately, as internal audits confirm rollouts remain incomplete at three major sites and monitoring controls are only in the pilot phase. 

I propose the revised holding statement read: "We acknowledge the serious operational and safety failures raised by regulators, which extend across multiple facilities and indicate unacceptable, systemic gaps in our oversight."

The accompanying Q&A framework must strictly compartmentalize our responses into three categories: confirmed multi-site failures, ongoing areas of internal investigation, and the exact, verifiable status of our remediation efforts. 

This candid approach ensures our public messaging aligns completely with internal audit realities, preserving regulatory defensibility and factual integrity without minimizing the severity of the breakdown.
